acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Deep Ones family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Fishman, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Gill-Gasp Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Hunched dull-grey fish humanoid with visible gills, wet scales, and a rusted hook or gutting knife.
Signature mechanic: Gasping Hook: the Fishman hunches behind a rusted hook or gutting knife, rushes once, then must flare its gills.
battlefieldDuty: Probe close spacing with a single hook rush followed by a visible gill recovery.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity ocean provenance, wetness, coral, T3+ lures, and bioluminescence remain aquatic biology, carried material, or habitat—not Water affinity or generic affinity glow.
Wet scales, gills, fins, barnacles, net, shell, rust, whale bone, and bounded native organ light retain physical origins with no elemental substitution.
counterplay: Sidestep the weapon line and strike the flared gill-neck during the forced gasp. Affinity signal: The established gill recovery, coral strap, lure line, translucent organ rhythm, or sovereign court anchor remains readable.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating ocean wetness, coral, lures, or bioluminescence as affinity evidence
identityInvariants: Hunched long-armed humanoid silhouette, wide flat head, lidless eyes, gill-neck, fins, webbed claws, and needle teeth remain legible.
Drowned green, deep-sea blue-black, sickly grey, pearlescent white, and bounded cold native light form the source palette.
Wet scale, eel skin, coral, barnacle, driftwood, rusted metal, whale bone, net, pearl, and shell remain distinct materials.
Pressure bulk, loss of familiar humanoid proportion, and native light-bearing anatomy escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: Lidless eyes fix forward, webbed claws tighten, and neck gills pinch shut.
